method: Reuse full-frame vector geometry; AI-defined scoped corrections, optional existing edge locator; no full-frame model training/inference.

release_criteria.source_and_coordinates: locked and per-object correspondence, no blind global overlay
release_criteria.scope_nonregression: all non-target objects byte-equivalent; approved blue native contour identical
release_criteria.geometry: all positive valid orthogonal, no new overlaps; retained AA objects unchanged
release_criteria.semantics: known false bars removed, neighboring tracks separated; AI checks all full-frame views
release_criteria.human: new ambiguous boundaries localized, old approved facts reused; full-frame completeness requires evidence
release_criteria.reproducibility: one spec entry, no case coordinates in code, outputs/negative tests restored
release_criteria.status: experimental until these gates are actually satisfied

restrictions: No new ML training or remote models
Original models/reviews and photo bytes immutable
Do not claim pixel accuracy, runtime improvement or whole-frame acceptance from geometry PASS
revision_note: Same scoped geometry plan; robust neighbor anchors improve unsupported photo-edge localization. Review UI has wide-context landmark labels; no ML training or changed material roles.
